title: Fermium Hazard Mapper v3.0
description: An open Python pipeline and web application that trains flood susceptibility models on flood extents mapped from Sentinel-1 radar, scores every model on whole areas held out from training, and publishes asset-level and administrative-level flood and landslide risk for Bangladesh. Version 3.0 runs a national partition of eight flood regions over all 61 lowland districts plus the Chittagong Hill Tracts landslide region, and serves it through a FastAPI and MapLibre web application at https://fermium.systems/hazmapper.
